name: PunisherFinTheme
overview: Selectable, accent-aware designs for Jellyfin Web.
description: Offers complete PunisherFin and Cinema Deck designs for cards, episodes, details, previews, and players while preserving Jellyfin's native behavior.

versions.changelog: Applies the configured global accent color to every home, library, continue-watching, and detail-card action, including Jellyfin 12 secondary more and favorite controls and their MUI variants. PunisherFin branding now also survives Jellyfin's late mobile and browser updates: the document title and favicon are continuously synchronized, nested mobile header labels are detected, and server identity entries in mobile drawers are no longer limited to desktop dashboard markup.

Fixes the design gallery on dynamically loaded Jellyfin settings pages. The preview styles are now delivered as a dedicated embedded plugin resource and injected into Jellyfin's actual document with an explicit cache-safe version, so the selectable homepage miniatures and live preview can no longer collapse into unstyled inline text.
